fieldValues.title: How does an agent guide a writer through domain → personas → problems → remedies → claims, and where are the reference fragments browsed?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The owner (vignette 24c38533-b35a-470a-bd78-42eca4bc0258): an agent should be able to help add and process reference material and build a library of fragments; the writer should see what reference material exists, browse quotes and citations and see how they link to problems and remedies; a connected agent should read the internal help and suggest the process; the process may be one of many packages, each shipping its own editor. Similar problems checked before writing (srs find, 2026-11-03): SP-85 (an essay cannot show the domain, problems, claims and remedies it speaks about), SP-57 (outside material cannot become quotable evidence), SP-54, SP-106, SP-101 (the method was designed before there were tools to practise it). No new problem is suggested: these hold the question. What exists: the argument package (problem, source, quotation, claim; srs-rust muSrs), srs-web's essay references pool (plans/519) and domain map (srs-web#571), srs-lab/strata (texts → fragments, problems, claims, quotes), the Method editor (MethodShell), and help as data (9441693e) which an agent reads through ui_help.
fieldValues.tensions:
- A: a strata lens graduated from srs-lab into srs-web (ADR-025): browse texts, quotes, problems and remedies as one surface. Leads to: the lab work pays off; a third shell to keep in step with the essay editor.
- B: a references and quotes browser inside the essay editor (extends the references pool): quotes, their sources and the problems and remedies they bear on, from the essay. Leads to: one surface for the writer; the library stays per-essay-repository.
- C: a package-shipped editor per decision 9a5e18a1 (views, dispatch composition, theme carried by the argument package; a generic shell lays it out). Leads to: every package can bring its own management screens; needs the generic block shell (srs-web#694) first.
- Agent guidance in every option: the process (domain, personas, problems, remedies, claims) written as concept help records the agent reads through ui_help, with a protocol in the package when the engine's protocol runs can carry it.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
- Which evidence chooses: how many of the writer's reference acts happen inside an essay (B) against across essays (A, C)? Count from the first three outside writers' sessions once the essay home ships.
- Does the argument package install cleanly into an essay repository in srs-web today (Install/Upgrade offers; finding 3fdecbe9 trap)? If not, B and C both wait on that.
- Can the engine's protocol runs carry the guidance, or do concept help records suffice for the first version?
fieldValues.next_action: File the unit for this exercise under semanticops.com#29 once the essay home unit is in build; check the argument package install path in srs-web; read srs-lab/strata DECISIONS.md S1 for what graduation needs.
